How it works

CATCH. RELEASE. REPEAT.

The physical mechanism stays easy to understand before the Mission Hub appears.

1 · TossSend the ball toward the other paddle.

Recommended age range
3–12AGES

JUMVI’s current recommended age range is 3–12. The paddle uses a hand-strap format rather than a racket handle, with the same physical game shown across several child age bands.

Questions

THE ESSENTIALS.

Quick answers about the set, players, age range and Mission Hub.

What comes in the JUMVI set?
4 paddles, 4 sticky balls, a mesh carry bag, printed retail box and QR Mission Card.
How many people can play?
The product configuration supports 2–4 players.
What ages is JUMVI for?
The current product age range is 3–12.
How many missions are included?
The Mission Hub contains 36 Guided Missions organized across 6 skill packs.
Do I need an app?
No app download is required. The Mission Hub runs in a mobile browser.
Do I need to create an account?
No sign-up is required to begin using the Mission Hub.
Where do I check price, stock and delivery?
Use the View on Amazon button for the current Amazon listing, price, stock and delivery information.
